hints.content: The ratio of shaded pieces to pieces per whole is $\redD{38}:25$.

Percent means per hundred.  

So, we need an equivalent ratio that will tell us how many pieces would be shaded out of $100$ pieces per whole.

|||
-|-|-|-
Shaded | $\redE{38}$ | $\stackrel{\times 4}\rightarrow$ | $\redE{152}$
Parts per whole | $25$ | $\stackrel{\times 4}\rightarrow$  | $100$
$\redD{152}\%$ is represented by the shaded area.

question.content:
